1.

Whom have we but Thee Our thirst to quench here? Where every earthly spring runs dry, Thou alone art eternal.

2.

Our heart Thou dost fasten On heaven’s things with Thee; Ah, should the bride then let herself Be ensnared by the earth!

3.

Thou dost abundantly give us all, Not as the world gives. Thou who, to purchase us for God, Didst shed Thy blood here.

4.

None like God Can esteem that blood, Which once for our salvation Flowed for us on the cross.

5.

Ever more we enjoy, On the ground of this blood, Our Father’s tender love now— So rich, so great, so good.
